name: ModelVariant411_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant411us_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the 0x38-byte config record indexed by the request, gets three slot parts, uploads four texture images and sets up the 32-sprite swarm, band, sheet, ring, spoke, quad, web and trail records, otherwise it runs one frame (swarm from the config start frame, quads from phase 2, tint and fade) and returns 4 in phases 2-4, then 1 once and 2; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md); notes/overlays/model-variants.md
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every image; the PAL images build it through french_model_variant/variant428_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and the PAL palette x; HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
